name: healthcare-appointment-manager
description: Full-stack Healthcare Appointment & Follow-up Manager platform with LLM triage, calendar sync, and dual-party notifications.

scripts.render-build: npm --prefix backend install && cd backend && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push && node prisma/seed.js && cd .. && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
